workouts.description: The classic circuit of twelve exercises, thirty seconds each with ten seconds' rest between them, from Klika and Jordan's 2013 article for the American College of Sports Medicine. You need a wall and a sturdy chair. Each exercise is a chapter, so you can repeat the circuit's hardest ones or skip any you can't do; push-ups and crunches ask for your count.
workouts.title: The 7-Minute Workout

workouts.description: The classic circuit of twelve exercises, thirty seconds each, with the talking done in rest chapters: each rest explains the exercise after it, so the thirty seconds of work have only the tones and a cue or two. You need a wall and a sturdy chair. Push-ups and crunches ask for your count. For a countdown into each exercise, choose 3-2-1 in Settings, End of Rest.
workouts.title: The 7-Minute Workout, Talked Through

workouts.description: Solo practice for one court, about 50 minutes: straight drives, feeding and stepping in, drives from the front court and short sequences, between rounds of ghosting to the corners. Each drill has a target; hit every target in two sessions back to back to move up.
workouts.title: Squash solo - Phase 1 A: Drive & Move

workouts.description: Solo practice for one court, about 50 minutes: short and ladder volleys, volley heights, drops, the serve and length, between rounds of ghosting. Each drill has a target; hit every target in two sessions back to back to move up.
workouts.title: Squash solo - Phase 1 B: Volley & Front Court

workouts.description: Solo practice for one court, about 50 minutes, on the front of the court and the back: length by height, drops and lobs, boasts, and length when tired, between rounds of ghosting to reach the front early.
workouts.title: Squash solo - Focus: Drops, Lobs & Length

workouts.description: The figure of eight in fifteen levels, from front-wall hits with a bounce to the full corner volley drill. Based on The Pursuit of Squash.
workouts.title: Squash solo - Ladder: Figure of Eight

workouts.description: Side wall to side wall in fifteen levels, from single drives to continuous volleys, moving up and down the court on the way. Based on The Pursuit of Squash.
workouts.title: Squash solo - Ladder: Side to Side

workouts.description: The volley in ten levels, from volleys close to the front wall to volleys from the short line, then the volley drop. Based on The Pursuit of Squash.
workouts.title: Squash solo - Ladder: Volleys
